description: Factory Droid exposes Studio Agent API v1 and records the selected Studio-managed CLI release. Native global continuation stays in its live Agent instance. Owner-scoped settings RPCs edit the native personal configuration used by the Global engine.

engineSelection.description: Selected npm release under the plugin engine directory. Empty release and version mark a removed installation.

release.description: Random local directory name, or empty after removal.

version.description: Published stable npm version, or empty after removal.

listNativeConfig.description: List personal resources from the native host home.

items.description: Skill directory or MCP entry name. Omitted for settings files.

readNativeConfig.description: Select one native document or MCP entry.

resource.description: Select the native personal SKILL.md, MCP, base settings or local settings layer.

name.description: Skill directory or MCP entry name. Omitted for settings files.

nativeConfigDocument.description: Editor view of a native document with sensitive MCP values replaced by null.

path.description: Canonical path to the personal native backing file.

revision.description: Opaque hash of the backing native file at read time; used to detect stale writes.

text.description: Skill Markdown, a projected settings object or a projected MCP entry.

exists.description: Whether the selected entry or file already exists.

saveNativeConfig.description: Save an updated personal document or MCP entry if it has not changed.

resource.description: Select the native personal SKILL.md, MCP, base settings or local settings layer.

name.description: Skill directory or MCP entry name. Omitted for settings files.

revision.description: Opaque hash of the backing native file at read time; used to detect stale writes.

text.description: UTF-8 Markdown or JSON editor contents. MCP null values keep existing private values.

removeNativeConfig.description: Remove one personal skill entry point or MCP server.

name.description: Skill directory or MCP entry name. Omitted for settings files.

revision.description: Opaque hash of the backing native file at read time; used to detect stale writes.

ok.description: Always true after a successful operation.

list-native-config.description: List only native personal skill or MCP entries.

read-native-config.description: Read one owner-authorized personal entry or projected settings document.

save-native-config.description: Validate and replace the selected personal entry under a revision guard.

remove-native-config.description: Remove the selected entry point or one server under a revision guard.

engineSelection.scope: Plugin data directory, shared by the activating owner and Studio Agent Manager
engineSelection.description: Atomically selected release in droid-engine/current.json. An absent file enables external discovery.
